summary.headline: Astrological Questions and Lunar Applications
summary.text: Catalog of astrological chapters on the midheaven, stellar forms and enmities, lost objects and thieves, runaways, Ptolemy’s Karpos, zodiacal outcomes, planetary significations, the Moon’s void of course, ascending-node conjunctions, and lunar applications to stars. It cites Dorotheus, Ptolemy’s Fructus, Codex 7, and Codex Florentinus 7.
